title: NYC OTI Senior Product Manager application resume
targetOrganization: NYC Office of Technology and Innovation
targetRole: Senior Product Manager, Public Interest Technology Crew
humanReviewGates: Jamie approves the exact resume before submission.
NYC OTI determines civil-service minimum-qualification eligibility.
The resume does not claim formal government product ownership, audited WCAG or Section 508 conformance, or causal responsibility for collective policy outcomes.

criteria.criterion: The resume lives under a stable date and exact job-application directory bound to Job ID 782366.
The Markdown uses standard ATS headings and avoids tables, images, and first-person prose.
The resume truthfully exposes the posting's end-to-end resident-facing product lifecycle, cross-functional delivery, launch, measurement, accessibility, and privacy language.
Role language is supported by governed project names, collaborators, and bounded quantitative evidence.
Collaborative products and campaigns retain collaborator credit and reject sole-authorship language.
Accessibility familiarity is distinguished from audited compliance, and the resume does not invent formal government product ownership, formal research programs, or sole policy causation.
The exact Markdown candidate has a digest-bound, two-page, tagged US Letter PDF that preserves the approved resume typography and has passed visual inspection.
No private archive locator, identifier, correspondence, transcript, People metadata, or geolocation enters the application artifact.
